Shekhar etal., ACS Nano19(37)(2025), DOI10.1021/acsnano.5c10559, exact successful primary:
https://escholarship.org/content/qt25t5f4vr/qt25t5f4vr.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com
Selected Results/Discussion/Methods pp7--27 distinguish dense and nanoporous prepared hematite. Microscopy correlates metal formation and fracture; dissolved intermediates remain present. Thin films used43microgramoxide/cm2,30wt%NaOH,80C and a referenced electrode, not an ore electrolyzer. Synthetic morphology/preparation and additive-bearing battery electrodes are separate constructions. Natural hematite was least reactive in the thin-film comparison. No causal fracture-rate law, bulk-ore conversion, product separation, full-cell efficiency or service life is supplied. SI and cited originals were not followed.
